name: Failing Reason 6 Code
definition: Specifies the reason the transaction/instruction is failing settlement. Settlement on the instructed settlement date is no longer possible.

BLOC.name: Account Blocked
BLOC.definition: Your account is blocked, no instruction can settle over the account.

LINK.name: Pending Linked Instruction
LINK.definition: Your instruction is pending settlement because the instruction linked to it is pending.

LACK.name: Lack Of Securities
LACK.definition: Insufficient financial instruments in your account.

CYCL.name: Awaiting Next Settlement Cycle
CYCL.definition: Your instruction is confirmed in the local market or is ready for settlement, awaiting next settlement cycle.

SBLO.name: Securities Blocked
SBLO.definition: Financial instruments are blocked due to a corporate action event, realignment, etc.

LATE.name: Market Deadline Missed
LATE.definition: Instruction was received after market deadline.

PRSY.name: System On Hold
PRSY.definition: Transaction was put on hold/frozen by the system.

INBC.name: Incomplete Number Count
INBC.definition: Not all the instructions part of a pool have been received.
